objective: Implement the user-approved synthetic telemetry panel with recognizable reference composition
first_glance: A compact instrument panel organizes one dominant circular reading above subordinate trend and status information.
proof_slice: The primary reading, its trend and the narrow-layout rearrangement

references.source: Task-supplied approved synthetic reference; inspect actual bytes before lock

traits: One dominant circular reading retains the reference silhouette and numeric hierarchy
Trend and status use the approved compact alignment and calm material language
The narrow crop retains the reading and a reachable primary action
forbidden: Equal-weight cards that erase the dominant reading
A glossy three-dimensional dial replacing the approved flat instrument
Clipped reading or inaccessible primary action at the accepted narrow width

viewports.framing: Whole panel with neighboring navigation for scale
Accepted narrow composition with the primary action visible

medium.selected: HTML/CSS with a source-owned SVG instrument
medium.rationale: The approved target is a flat information panel with precise labels and responsive geometry.
rejected: Canvas would complicate selectable labels and semantics without a visual need
Three-dimensional rendering would change the reference material and hierarchy
medium.switch_condition: If the proposed primitive cannot retain the approved silhouette and label alignment at both required widths after a bounded geometry repair, replace that primitive and repeat the proof slice.

incomplete_wording: Planned target only. The reference has not been inspected or locked and no candidate has been visually reviewed.
